# Soundfont samples

Per-note MP3 renderings of the FluidR3_GM soundfont (MIT license),
taken from Benjamin Gleitzman's midi-js-soundfonts project
(https://github.com/gleitz/midi-js-soundfonts, MIT license) and
converted from their `-mp3.js` wrappers to plain JSON
(note name → data URI) for Night Roll's sampled voices.

FluidR3_GM by Frank Wen, MIT license.
